rootCauseFinding.summary: Tailwind arbitrary z-index value `z-[var(--falcon-dialog-z-index)]` resolves to computed `z-index: auto` because the CSS custom property `--falcon-dialog-z-index` is NOT defined anywhere in the cascade (not on :root, not on any ancestor).
evidence: backdropComputedZIndex == 'auto' (a Tailwind arbitrary value referencing an undefined var collapses to the JIT-compiled `z-index: var(--falcon-dialog-z-index)` which yields 'auto' when the var is unset)
Walked all relevant Falcon CSS custom properties on the backdrop's computed style: no --falcon-dialog-z-index, --falcon-sc-z-index, --falcon-z-modal, or --falcon-z-overlay defined
Result: position:fixed + z-index:auto puts the backdrop in the parent's local stacking context at the order it was inserted, NOT on a top-most layer

The dialog wrapper element falcon-angular-sending-credentials-dialog is rendered INSIDE falcon-angular-wizard-finalization > app-org-hierarchy-page-menu (page content), NOT portalled to body or to .falcon-overlay-container
